subject: Activation cadence & ownership lattice for Olive Systems kickoff
messages:
From: Claire Bennett <claire@olive-sys.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Dan Park <dan.park@olive-sys.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood MAP & schedule — Olive Systems kickoff

Hi Neha — great to connect last week. Per our conversation, Olive is ready to lock in a mutual action plan and a clear ownership spine so we can hit production before end of Q3. Attached is a brief priority list from our side.

Top goals:
- Staging-ready prototype with sample dataset (ingest + embedding)
- SSO + provisioning for 10 pilot users
- Performance target: < 400ms median gen for primary routes

Proposed high-level milestones (we're flexible):
1) Kickoff & requirements capture — week of Jun 7
2) Data ingestion + schema runbook — Jun 14–25
3) Staging integration + smoke tests — Jul 5–16
4) Pilot (10 users) + feedback loop — Jul 19–Aug 6
5) Production cutover prep — Aug 9–20

Can you confirm an internal roster + owners for the boxes above and whether Redwood can commit a two-day engineering pairing window during the data ingestion sprint? We've attached Olive-implementation-priorities.xlsx for reference.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Bennett
Head of Product Operations, Olive Systems
[attachment: Olive-implementation-priorities.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Bennett <claire@olive-sys.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & schedule — Olive Systems kickoff

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear priorities and the attached list. Happy to run the MAP starting now and we can iterate on dates. Initial commitments from Redwood below:

Owners (first pass):
- Data ingestion & schema: Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.com) — owner for engineering pairing and ingestion runbook
- Staging integration + smoke tests: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwood.com) — will coordinate infra and test harness
- Pilot ops / user provisioning: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.com) — CS owner for pilot support and acceptance criteria
- Program lead / escalation: Neha Kapoor — overall PM and primary contact

We can commit a 2-day pairing window during Jun 14–25 for ingestion work; Marcus, can you confirm preferred dates?

I attached a lightweight MAP template (we'll produce a formal xlsx after Marcus/Priyam confirm dates). Proposed kickoff: Jun 8, 09:00 PT — 60 minutes (agenda: requirements alignment, access lists, success metrics). Will that work for you?

Next steps / asks from Olive before kickoff:
- SSO contact for SAML metadata (who will set up Okta/IdP?)
- A sample permissions matrix for the 10 pilot users
- Any compliance documentation needed earlier than our staging test (SOC2 items flagged)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-29T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & schedule — Olive Systems kickoff

Neha / Claire — quick notes from an engineering-readiness perspective:

- I can take the ingestion owner slot. Two-day pairing: Jun 15–16 looks best for my calendar and gives Olive a dedicated window.
- Risk callout: the sample dataset shows nested JSON objects and variable sequence lengths — we should plan for an early quantization/throughput check on staging to validate latency targets. Suggest we add a "performance smoke" milestone (2 business days) immediately after staging integration (target Jul 7–8).
- Priyom: can you reserve a staging host and enable the token-level tracing we use for latency regressions?

On the MAP spreadsheet I added an "acceptance tests" column so the pilot owners have explicit pass/fail criteria.

Marcus Lin
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

Thanks all — that schedule looks sensible and Jun 15–16 for ingestion pairing is great. A few items from our side:

- SSO: Dan Park will own IdP config and can share SAML metadata. Dan, I'll loop you into the kickoff invite.
- Staging data: we'll deliver a 3GB anonymized snapshot by Jun 10 (format: ndjson). If you can run the early performance smoke on Jul 7–8 that aligns well.
- Compliance: Olive can surface a SOC2 extractor report; we don't need full evidence before staging but will share the SOC2-HIPAA checklist this week.

I've uploaded a starter MAP to the shared Drive; link below. I'll also attach our SSO guide.

Claire
